failure_mode: The system gives that an action is not in a declared class when the action is in a declared class.
cause: A declared class does not match the action and the object of the action as the caller states them.
effect: An action that needs the authorization of the user occurs and no person answered for it. REQ-PL-013 names actions that no person can reverse.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces an effect to its record and reads the class that the record names as its authority.

failure_mode: The system gives that an action is in a declared class when the action is in no declared class.
cause: REQ-AU-008 makes the system answer that an action is in a declared class when the system cannot decide, and REQ-AU-020 gives that an act on the outside world is in a declared class until a class states that it needs none.
effect: The user answers requests that no class needed, and stops reading the requests that matter. The gate then holds an answer that the user did not consider.
detection: The user sees the number of requests that reach the user.
mitigation: DEC-067 and DEC-109. The acts that the platform can do are a named set, and a class that states that an act needs no authorization covers each use of that act that its condition names, so the requests that no class needed are bounded by declaration. What remains is a judgement that DEC-030 keeps out of the platform and MET-002 keeps out of this repository, so no requirement in this compartment names it.

failure_mode: The system does not report that a declared class was removed.
cause: DEC-055 removes a class on an answer of the user, and no statement makes the change visible after it occurs.
effect: Actions of that class stop reaching the user, and the user has no signal that the gate changed.
detection: The user reads the declared classes, or reads the unit of work that asked for the removal.

failure_mode: The classes that the system gives to a caller are not the classes that the system applies.
cause: The system answers a classification from one statement of the declared classes and gives another.
effect: An agent plans an act that it believes needs no answer of the user, and REQ-PL-027 is not met.
detection: A person compares the classes that the system gives with the answers that the system returns.

failure_mode: The system accepts the declaration of a class with no affirmative answer of the user.
cause: The system does not hold the declaration until the answer exists.
effect: A class exists that the user did not approve. An agent that declares a class stops the actions of another agent.
detection: The user receives a request for an action that the user did not expect to be gated.

failure_mode: The system does not answer a classification in the time that a boundary needs.
cause: Each act on the outside world waits for this answer (DEC-111), so every such caller queues behind every other.
effect: Each act on the outside world goes to the user as a request (DEC-110). No caller continues on its own judgement.
detection: The platform reports its own operational state under REQ-PL-017, as RSK-AD-005 is detected.

failure_mode: The system cannot give the declared classes after the loss of the host.
cause: A copy away from the host that does not carry the declared classes. REQ-PL-022 named life state and what states an agent only, until OPN-047 added the classes.
effect: REQ-AU-008 answers that each action is in a declared class, so each gated action stops until each class is proposed and answered again, one at a time.
detection: The platform reports its own operational state under REQ-PL-017.
mitigation: REQ-AU-015 and REQ-AU-016. DEC-058 holds a declaration apart from the four bodies of DEC-120, so the obligation on a body did not carry to this register on its own and REQ-PL-022 had to name it.

failure_mode: The system accepts the declaration of a class, a change to a class or the removal of a class from a caller whose position does not admit the act.
cause: The system does not refuse against the position of the caller.
effect: A class exists that no position admitted, or a class is gone that no position admitted the removal of. An agent stops the actions of another agent by declaring a class.
detection: A person reads the writer that REQ-AU-011 holds with each declared class.

failure_mode: The system holds as a party that counts as the user a party that is not the user.
cause: The agent that proposes the declaration states a party of a third party, and the user approves it.
effect: Each message to that party goes out with no answer of the user. REQ-PL-013 names it as an act that nobody can reverse.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a message to its record.
